meta_description: Colorfest Electric Night Run 2026: August 1 at SM Mall of Asia. A HyveSports night run at Manila Bay — registration pending.
dek: Set for 1 August 2026 at SM Mall of Asia in Pasay, this HyveSports production is a themed night run. Registration isn't open yet.
verdict: Colorfest Electric Night Run is a HyveSports-produced themed night race at SM Mall of Asia — Manila Bay's iconic waterfront venue. The 'electric' theme suggests neon lights, glow zones, and a party-atmosphere finish line. HyveSports (the team behind the Garmin Run Philippines) brings established race-production experience. Registration isn't open yet. For Manila runners wanting a themed night race experience at a proven venue, this is worth tracking.
